title: US Justice Department clears Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros
title_zh: 美国司法部批准派拉蒙收购华纳兄弟
summary: STORY: The U.S. Justice Department's (DOJ) Antitrust Division said it has cleared Paramount Skydance Corp's planned acquisition of Warner Bros.
summary_zh: 故事：美国司法部 (DOJ) 反垄断部门表示，已批准派拉蒙 Skydance 公司收购华纳兄弟的计划。

title: Paramount’s Deal for Warner Bros. Is Cleared by US DOJ
title_zh: 派拉蒙收购华纳兄弟的交易获得美国司法部批准
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The US Justice Department has closed an antitrust probe into Paramount Skydance Corp.’s $110 billion purchase of Warner Bros.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国司法部已结束对派拉蒙 Skydance Corp. 以 1100 亿美元收购华纳兄弟的反垄断调查。

title: US clears Paramount's $111 bn Warner Bros. takeover
title_zh: 美国批准派拉蒙以 1,110 亿美元收购华纳兄弟
summary: The US Justice Department on Friday cleared Paramount Skydance's $111 billion takeover of Warner Bros.A group of Democratic senators led by Elizabeth Warren had warned that a Warner Bros.
summary_zh: 美国司法部周五批准了派拉蒙 Skydance 以 1,110 亿美元收购华纳兄弟的交易。以伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 为首的一群民主党参议员警告说，华纳兄弟将收购华纳兄弟。

title: Times Square’s New Year’s Eve Ball Joins SpaceX Takeover of NYC
title_zh: 时代广场的除夕舞会加入 SpaceX 收购纽约市的行列
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Even the iconic New Year’s Eve ball is getting involved in the SpaceX IPO celebrations.
summary_zh: (彭博社)——就连标志性的除夕舞会也参与了 SpaceX 的 IPO 庆祝活动。

title: Accounting Firm Crowe to Sell Stake to KKR in Nearly $3 Billion Deal
title_zh: Crowe 会计师事务所将以近 30 亿美元的交易向 KKR 出售股份
summary: The private-equity giant and co-investors would take a majority interest in a firm long resistant to outside ownership.
summary_zh: 这家私募股权巨头和联合投资者将获得一家长期抵制外部所有权的公司的多数股权。
